config.description: Truthy logs the fetchproxy bridge's role and lifecycle to stderr.

config.label: What a confirmation-gated write does on a client without a confirmation prompt: ask-user (default), auto, or refuse
config.description: What a confirmation-gated write does on a client without a confirmation prompt: ask-user (default), auto, or refuse.

config.label: on (default) confirms writes with an MCP elicitation prompt when the client supports one; off always uses the MCP_CONFIRM_MODE path
config.description: on (default) confirms writes with an MCP elicitation prompt when the client supports one; off always uses the MCP_CONFIRM_MODE path.

config.label: Meal-planner profiles as an inline JSON array (wins over HELLOFRESH_PROFILES_FILE)
config.description: Meal-planner profiles as an inline JSON array (wins over HELLOFRESH_PROFILES_FILE). Unset: the file, else the built-in couple/family profiles.

config.label: Path to a JSON file of meal-planner profiles
config.description: Path to a JSON file of meal-planner profiles. Defaults to ~/.config/hellofresh-mcp/profiles.json, read only when it exists.

config.label: Where the HelloFresh session is kept across restarts (token set only, 0600)
config.description: Where the HelloFresh session is kept across restarts (token set only, 0600). Defaults to .hellofresh-mcp/session.json under MCP_DATA_DIR, else HOME.

config.label: on (default) keeps the session on disk across restarts; false keeps it in memory only
config.description: on (default) keeps the session on disk across restarts; false keeps it in memory only.
